title: 'Will find way forward through dialogue': Amit Shah assures Arunachal locals amid Siang dam protests

ai.summary: Union home minister Amit Shah visited Arunachal Pradesh to address concerns over the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, assuring locals that the government would protect their traditions, culture and religious beliefs through dialogue.

facts.claim: Union home minister Amit Shah visited Arunachal Pradesh to address concerns over the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project
facts.quote: Union home minister Amit Shah, who is visiting Arunachal Pradesh amid protests against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP), assured locals on Saturday that the Centre would protect their traditions, culture and religious beliefs.

facts.claim: Amit Shah assured locals that the government would protect their traditions, culture and religious beliefs through dialogue
facts.quote: I want to assure my brothers and sisters from Siang that we will find a way forward through positive dialogue ... You need not worry about it. The government and I have the same respect you have for the local culture. We will move forward without compromising the traditions, culture and religion of this place,

ai.background_note: The Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) is a proposed 11,200-MW dam on the Siang River in Arunachal Pradesh, which indigenous groups oppose due to concerns over ancestral lands, environment, and cultural impact.
